editorial.blurb: Koreana serves deeply authentic Korean dishes with high-quality meats and banchan that inspire fierce loyalty—the kind of place where regulars return monthly and newcomers instantly feel at home.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the kimchi fried rice as a side (it tastes even better the next day, according to staff), and don't miss the prime beef options; the 90% Korean clientele is your compass.
